body:
Phase 1 — Dendro R1 (v0.1.0) acceptance. FROZEN. Sponsor approved 2026-10-10 17:01Z. PM decision: proceed (PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION.md §12).

Outcome: the operator answers seat, handoff and cost questions for a named rig and period, from local logs, with every number traceable to its source. The reference rig is agentflow-dev (2026-10-08..10). dendro-dev has 0 queue items today, so O8 there waits for real work.

Public journey: (1) run one ingest command; see sources found and missing, with record counts (<= 5 min). (2) see harness sessions linked to rig and seat, or shown as unlinked, with the link rate. (3) Q1 seat activity: active, idle with work, idle without work, waiting on human, unknown. (4) Q2 handoffs: count per pair, returns with chain path, intake cost labelled as an estimate. (5) Q3 tokens per mission and seat; tool loops and handoff loops. (6) Decision metrics: M1 seat yield, M2 handoff efficiency, M3 build rework by chain, M4 skill exposure (impact = insufficient data). (7) Trace any number to its file and line, or table and key. (8) A re-run without changes leaves every total unchanged.

Acceptance: AC1-AC11 Given-When-Then in docs/ACCEPTANCE_R1.md §5. Metric definitions are in §4. The capability map (9 module IDs, build order) is in §2.

Required harnesses: OpenRig, Claude Code, Codex, Pi (A1, sponsor-accepted). AGY and Grok come next in the same release and do not block. Pi sessions live under ~/.openrig/state/pi/<session>/sessions.

Constraints: local-first; read-only on sources (hash unchanged); no prompt or response content, tool output or secrets in the analytic store; stack Rust + DuckDB + Nao (sponsor decision, do not reopen); an unknown format line warns with file and line and never changes totals; currency only where the source records cost or the operator supplies prices.

Anti-goals: not SaaS or cloud APM; does not control agents; does not judge code quality (M1 is not value); does not guess links; does not invent prices or skill impact.

Out of scope: G2 (NL/Nao dashboards, alerts, continuous mode), G3 connector guide, G4 site, brand and docs (Antigravity), non-rig sessions beyond 'unlinked' totals.

Assumptions A1-A8: docs/ACCEPTANCE_R1.md §6. Facts F1-F4 were measured read-only on 2026-10-10 (§1).

Unknowns for orch.arch: U5 format stability of Codex, AGY, Pi, Grok; U6 Nao over local DuckDB (G2); U9 AGY and Grok token and cost formats. U1 is resolved: agent.session_identity events give deterministic linking (85/87).

References: docs/ACCEPTANCE_R1.md, docs/PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION.md (§11, §12), .agentflow/PRODUCT.md, docs/architecture.md (reference only, not a requirement).
